s: Din shalosh seuddot ubo ch' seipim: yehe zahir meod leqayyem seudda shelishit. Veap im hu sabea — hare yakol leqayyem otah (beyoter mikkebetza meat abal) kebetza. Veap shekkebetza hi seuddat aray (veeno [yotze bah]), mikkol maqom meachar sheyyesh bah kede sebia — niqra seudda (veyotze bah). (Veyesh omerim sheapillu bikzayit yotze yede chobato lekattechilla bekol achat mishshalosh seuddot, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman trl"t. Veyesh lehachamir lekattechilla kasbara harishona im epshar lo). Veim i epshar lo leekol kelal — en tzarik letzaer et atzmo leekol, shesseuddot hashshabbat leoneg nitztavvu velo letzaar. Abal hechakam enayv berosho shello lemallot bitno bisuddat habboqer, kede litten maqom lisudda shelishit:

Zeman seudda g' hu mishsheyyaggia zeman mincha gedola ad haereb, dehaynu mishshesh shaot umechetza veelak. Veim asaah qodem leken — lo qiyyem mitzvat seudda shelishit, ella im ken nimshak bah ad achar hammincha, sheakal (yoter mi)kebetza achar shesh umechetza, abal lekattechilla gam hatchalat hasseudda tehe achar shesh umechetza. Ulehaomerim shemmishshehiggia zeman mincha gedola asur liqboa apillu seudda qetanna ad sheyyitpallel mincha techilla, kemo shennitbaer besimman rl"b — tzarik lehitpallel leolam mincha qodem seudda shelishit. Veken nohagim bimdinot ellu. Abal hammattirim liqboa seudda qodem tepillat hammincha omerim shebbeshabbat tob leekol seudda g' qodem tepillat hammincha, lepi shebben mincha lemaarib beben hashshemashot asur lishtot mayim betok hasseudda o achareha, mippene shehu qarob lizman chazarat hanneshamot legehinnom bemotzae shabbat, vehashshoteh az mayim mehannahar — hare zeh gozel et hammetim, shemmitqorerim bemayim qodem chazaratam, veyesh chashash sakkana baddabar. Ulepi minhagenu sheanu okelim ben mincha lemaarib — yesh lanu lizzaher shello lishtot az mayim shennishabu az mehannahar, ella mayim shebbabbayit shennishabu qodem leken mehannahar, o shear mashqim. Veyesh omerim sheissur zeh shel shetiyyat mayim mehannahar beben hashshemashot hu beereb shabbat, shemmitqorerim kesheyyotzeim mehaggehinnom. Vetob lachush gam ledibrehem:

Im nimsheka seuddat habboqer ad shehiggia zeman mincha gedola sheaz matchil zeman seudda g' — tob sheyyapsiq hasseudda vibarek birkat hammazon, veyittol yadayv miyyad vibarek hammotzi al lechem mishneh veyisod, sheim lo yaaseh ken, meachar shennimsheka seuddat habboqer ad otah shaa — lo yukal leekol achar kak seudda g' ella akila gassa, abal miyyad samuk laakila adayin haitztumeka petucha. Umikkol maqom, kede shello yehe nireh shehakkol seudda achat — tob lehapsiq meat achar birkat hammazon bedibre tora o betiyyul qetzat. Vetob gam ken laqum velelek meat, velo lehishshaer yosheb bimqomo ap shemmapsiq meat bedibre tora. Abal im eno mapsiq bebirkat hammazon, ap shemmapsiq harbeh bidbarim acherim ubetiyyul — hare hakkol nechshab seudda achat. Veen issur bemah shemmapsiq bebirkat hammazon vegorem lachazor ulebarek hammotzi ubirkat hammazon al gemar hasseudda shehaya yakol legomrah qodem birkat hammazon, vahare zeh gorem beraka sheenah tzerika, dekevan shemmapsiq bishbil kebod shabbat — en kan mishshum marbeh bibrakot shello letzorek. Abal en lidrosh ken barabbim, kevan sheqqodem chatzot eno yakol lehapsiq bebirkat hammazon velatzet yede chobat seudda g' bemah sheyyokal achar birkat hammazon, veen haolam beqiim bahalaka zo lechalleq ben qodem chatzot leachar chatzot, ella kol adam yaaseh ken leatzmo:

Abal mi sheyyodea beatzmo sheepshar lo leekol achar sheyyitpallel mincha betzibbur — tob sheyyitpallel mincha betzibbur techilla veachar kak yokal seudda g' kemo shennohagin. Vaapillu im chal yom tob bemotzae shabbat, shei epshar lo leekol seudda g' ben mincha lemaarib, shehare mitzva lehimmana milliqboa seudda beereb yom tob mishshaa asirit ulemala kemo beereb shabbat, mikkol maqom im yodea sheyyukal leekol qodem shaa asirit — en lo lechalleq seuddat habboqer lishtayim al yede hepseq birkat hammazon, lepi sheyyesh omerim sheyyesh kan mishshum marbeh bibrakot shello letzorek. Veim abar vechilleqah lishtayim — yatza, veen tzarik lachazor veleekol seudda g' ap al pi sheepshar lo, ben shehu ereb yom tob ben sheeno ereb yom tob:

Mi sheyyesh lo mezon b' seuddot leshabbat veim yechalleqem leg' seuddot lo yihyeh lo lekol seudda lesoba — mutab sheyyokal b' seuddot lesoba, veal yokal g' shello lesoba. Umikkol maqom, im nimsheka seuddat habboqer ad shehiggia zeman mincha gedola — yechalleqah lishtayim al yede hepseq birkat hammazon kemo shennitbaer, shehare yisba kesheyyokal shenit miyyad. Abal lekattechilla en lehamtin im seuddat habboqer ad samuk lemincha gedola bishbil qiyyum seudda g', shehare asur lehitannot ad chatzot, kemo shennitbaer besimman rp"ch. (Umikkol maqom, ap kesheokel babboqer — tob lo sheyyechalleqenna lishtayim al yede hepseq birkat hammazon, lepi sheyyesh omerim sheyyotze bazeh yede chobat seudda g'. Veap shehaiqqar kehaomerim shezzeman seudda g' hu min hammincha ulemala kemo shennitbaer, mikkol maqom kevan sheen lo bammeh leqayyemah bizmannah — tob sheyyeqayyemenna babboqer, sheyyeqayyemenna lepi sebara zo ap sheenah iqqar, mimmah shello yeqayyemenna kelal):

Bisudda g' en tzarik leqaddesh al hayyayin, dehaynu lebarek al hakkos qodem hasseudda kemo qodem seuddat shacharit, lepi shello tiqqenu chakamim qiddush bayyom ella keen qiddush shebballayla, umah ballayla day beqiddush echad — ap bayyom day beqiddush echad shebbeshacharit:

Abal tzarik libtzoa al shette kikkarot shelemot kemo bisuddot harishonot. Vaapillu soed peamim harbeh beshabbat — tzarik lekol seudda lechem mishneh. Veyesh omerim sheapillu lisudda g' day bekikkar echad shalem, lepi shebbeyom v' yarad hamman lekol echad shene omarim, umikkol omer asu shette kikkarot, hare d' kikkarot leb' omarim, akal achat mehen beyom v', veachat belel shabbat, veachat babboqer — nishara kikkar echad shalem lisudda g'. Veken nitpashshet hamminhag lehaqel bimdinot ellu libtzoa bisudda g' al kikkar echad shalem. Abal yesh lehachamir liqqach shenayim kasbara harishona shehu iqqar, ella im ken en lo shenayim, sheaz lo yipchot mikkikkar echad shalem. Abal yesh meqillin od sheyyakol leqayyem seudda g' bekol maakal heasuy mechameshet hamminim shemmebarekim alayv "bore mine mezonot", shehu niqra mazon. Veyesh meqillin od sheyyakol leqayyemah gam ken bidbarim shedderek lelappet bahen et happat, kegon basar vedagim vekayyotze bahem, abal lo beperot. Veyesh meqillin od sheapillu beperot yakol leqayyemah. Veen lismok kelal al kol zeh, ella im ken i epshar kelal beinyan acher, kegon shehu sabea beyoter vei epshar lo leekol pat belo sheyyetzaer et atzmo. Veken ereb pesach shechal lihyot beshabbat, shei epshar leekol pat bimdinot ellu sheen nohagin bematztza ashira, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman ta"a:
Nashim chayyabot bisudda shelishit kemo anashim, veken libtzoa al b' kikkarot bekol seudda, shellekol maaseh shabbat ish veishsha shavin, mittaam shennitbaer besimman ra"a:
